in_sanskrit.name: Sonjoy
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Joy of the Sun
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sonjoy एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sonjoy is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Son' which means 'Sun' and 'Joy' which means 'Happiness'. The name signifies the joy that one experiences from the radiance of the Sun. In Hindu culture, the Sun is considered as a symbol of energy, power, and prosperity.
